name: Camping Seeblick Toni
beschreibung: The campsite Seeblick Toni is located in Kramsach right on the shores of Lake Reintaler See. Its location provides direct access to the water and expansive views of the surrounding alpine scenery. The site features level pitches for caravans and motorhomes as well as connections for fresh water and waste disposal. The proximity to the lake offers great opportunities for swimming and water sports. The village of Kramsach offers shopping facilities and restaurants. This campsite is an ideal choice for guests who love staying by the water.
